meta.title: My Story Title
meta.author: Your Name
meta.blurb: A one- or two-sentence teaser shown on the title screen.

first-scene.text: Scene text goes here. Use \n\n for paragraph breaks.

choices.text: A choice with requirements and effects
choices.lockedText: shown on the disabled button when requirements fail

second-scene.text: Scenes can apply effects automatically when entered, via onEnter.

write-in-scene.text: A writeIn scene has no buttons at first: the active player writes their action in their own words. In two-player modes, the OTHER player then judges it by picking one of the outcomes below. Solo players judge themselves. Written moves appear in the journey recap.

writeIn.prompt: The question the player answers in their own words.

outcomes.text: Label the judge sees, e.g. 'That works — brilliantly'

death-scene.text: Players land here automatically if a statDeath stat drops to 0 (or via a failed roll above).

an-ending.text: Ending scenes have an 'ending' field and no choices. The engine tracks which endings the player has found.

ending.name: Name Shown in the Endings List
